verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an API versioning policy: a new endpoint version ships whenever a backwards-incompatible change is released. Versioned endpoints (v2 customer/audit endpoints, v3 transaction processing) appear in the reference docs. The deprecation half of the story is not evidenced: there is no documented policy on deprecation notice, sunset timelines or support windows for old versions, and the 308 redirect only hints at how a single endpoint migrated. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice periods, version support windows, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.
